name: gramIsHermitian
doc: Gram 矩阵 `Aᵀ A`（`n × n`）是 Hermitian（ℝ 上即对称）。
stmt: def gramIsHermitian (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) : (Aᵀ * A).IsHermitian

name: singularValueSq
doc: 奇异值**平方** `σᵢ²`：`Aᵀ A` 的第 `i` 个特征值。
stmt: def singularValueSq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin n) : ℝ

name: singularValueSq_nonneg
doc: 奇异值平方非负（由 `Aᵀ A` 半正定）。
stmt:
theorem singularValueSq_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ singularValueSq A i
proof:
by
  unfold singularValueSq gramIsHermitian
  exact Matrix.eigenvalues_conjTranspose_mul_self_nonneg A i

name: singularValue
stmt: def singularValue (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin n) : ℝ

name: singularValue_nonneg
stmt:
theorem singularValue_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ singularValue A i

name: singularValue_sq
doc: 奇异值的平方回原：`σᵢ² = σᵢ²`（开方后平方）。
stmt:
theorem singularValue_sq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    singularValue A i ^ 2 = singularValueSq A i

name: tailSingularValueSq
doc: 尾部平方和 `∑_{i > k} σᵢ²`（截断误差的谱量；此处仅作定义）。
stmt: def tailSingularValueSq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i in (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => k < i.val)), singularValueSq A i

name: tailSingularValueSq_nonneg
stmt:
theorem tailSingularValueSq_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ tailSingularValueSq A k
proof:
by
  unfold tailSingularValueSq
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => singularValueSq_nonneg A i)

name: tailSingularValueSq_le_total
doc: 尾部平方和 ≤ 全部平方和（仅用非负性）。
stmt:
theorem tailSingularValueSq_le_total (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    tailSingularValueSq A k ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, singularValueSq A i
proof:
by
  unfold tailSingularValueSq
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    (fun i _ _ => singularValueSq_nonneg A i)

name: frobenius_sq_eq_sum_singularValueSq
doc: **`∑ᵢ σᵢ² = ‖A‖_F²`**：全部奇异值平方和等于 Frobenius 范数平方。
stmt:
theorem frobenius_sq_eq_sum_singularValueSq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, singularValueSq A i) = frobeniusNorm A ^ 2
proof:
by
  have h1 : Matrix.trace (Aᵀ * A) = ∑ i : Fin n, singularValueSq A i :=
    symmetric_trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues (Aᵀ * A) (gramIsHermitian A)
  rw [← h1, ← sum_sq_eq_trace_transpose_mul A, frobeniusNorm_sq]

name: frobeniusNorm_nonneg_error
doc: 误差的 Frobenius 范数非负（最优误差非负的下界性）。
stmt:
theorem frobeniusNorm_nonneg_error (A B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    0 ≤ frobeniusNorm (A - B)

name: rankZero_exact
doc: **k = 0 的精确情形**：零矩阵是精确近似，`‖A − 0‖_F = ‖A‖_F`。
stmt:
theorem rankZero_exact (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    frobeniusNorm (A - 0) = frobeniusNorm A

name: eym_lower_bound_triangle
doc:
**三角不等式下界**：`‖A − B‖_F ≥ ‖A‖_F − ‖B‖_F`
（由 Frobenius 三角不等式 `RealLowRank.frob_add_le` 导出）。
stmt:
theorem eym_lower_bound_triangle (A B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    frobeniusNorm (A - B) ≥ frobeniusNorm A - frobeniusNorm B
proof:
by
  have h0 : frobeniusNorm A ≤ frobeniusNorm (A - B) + frobeniusNorm B := by
    have h := frob_add_le (m := Fin m) (n := Fin n) (A - B) B
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
    exact h
  linarith

name: bestApprox_self
doc: 自近似误差为 0：`B = A` 时 `‖A − A‖_F = 0`（配合非负性即最小可能误差）。
stmt:
theorem bestApprox_self (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    frobeniusNorm (A - A) = 0
